result.note: Tested the venue of the August 2026 Saudi Arabia–Turkey–Pakistan collective defence pact and Turkey's standing within NATO.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan formalised a collective defence pact. Consider the following statements about it:
items: The pact was formalised in Mecca.
One of its members has NATO's second-largest military.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both are correct. The pact was formalised in Mecca on 10 August 2026, and it brings together Gulf capital and NATO's second-largest military, Turkey's. India watches this bloc closely.
questions.source: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan formalised a collective defence pact in Mecca, adding Gulf capital and NATO's second-largest military to a bloc India keeps a close eye on.
